test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Accounting is rightly referred to as the '_______ of business'.
solution:
The correct answer is **language.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Language of Business:**

 
 
• Accounting is often referred to as the "language of business" because it is the medium through which financial information is communicated to stakeholders.
 
• It provides a systematic way of recording, reporting, and analyzing financial transactions, which is essential for decision-making within a business.
 
• Through financial statements, accounting conveys the economic activities and conditions of a business to managers, investors, regulators, and other stakeholders.
 
• This helps in understanding the financial health and performance of a business, thereby facilitating informed decision-making.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vision:**

 
 
• Vision refers to the long-term goals and aspirations of a business. It is a forward-looking statement that outlines what the business aims to achieve in the future.
 
• While important for strategic direction, vision is not a term that captures the essence of accounting's role in business communication.
 
 
 
• **Perception:**
 
 
• Perception relates to the way stakeholders view or understand the business, which can be influenced by branding, public relations, and marketing.
 
• Perception is subjective and does not directly relate to the systematic and objective nature of accounting.
 
 
 
• **Mission:**
 
 
• Mission defines the core purpose and values of a business. It is a statement that articulates what the business does, for whom, and why.
 
• While the mission is crucial for guiding business operations, it does not encapsulate the communicative function of accounting.
